messages.text: Honestly? At month 8, joined a research group [E-A-001]. Most of what I'm learning is applied specialism [ev_A_003]. My role these days: graduated; first role after the degree [ev_A_003]. That's the part of this life I think about most.

I see it differently. At month 6, finished first performance cycle [E-B-001]. Most of what I'm learning is technical leadership on projects [ev_B_003]. My role these days: senior engineer [ev_B_003]. That's the part of this life I think about most.
Fair, but from where I'm standing: What worries me most: two years of lost income and tuition costs [ev_A_007]. Stress? medium [ev_A_006]. That's the part of this life I think about most.
